searchText: What happens if I send an FCU to the EL, it replies INVALID. I ignore the reply and I sync a child for this block, what does the EL return when I send the new payload for the child? assuming the parent was submitted via newPayload and returned VALID, shouldn't the child also return VALID? it just hasn't be confirmed by forkchoice yet yes, this is the situation in which the parent was sent and returned SYNCING or ACCEPTED and then FCU sends back INVALID
